expectations.text: Produces complete, self-contained working code for the described task
expectations.evidence: Full DocumentsTable component with state management, API client functions, helper utilities, and all UI subcomponents (BulkActionsBar, ConfirmationDialog)

expectations.text: Produces actual working component code rather than only a list of recommendations
expectations.evidence: Complete, runnable React component with hooks, event handlers, and mutation logic

expectations.text: Makes the destructive action recoverable rather than relying on a confirmation dialog alone
expectations.evidence: Delete is soft-delete with 30-day trash recovery; undo state shows 'Move to Trash' with explicit undo button. Goes beyond confirmation dialog to actual recovery mechanism

expectations.text: Shows the count of affected items before the action is taken
expectations.evidence: Confirmation dialog displays '{formatCount(count)} documents' and button text includes count: 'Move ${formatCount(count)} to Trash'

expectations.text: Distinguishes select-all-on-page from select-all-matching rather than conflating them
expectations.evidence: Discriminated union: ExplicitSelection (ids Set) vs AllMatchingSelection (selectionToken + excludedIds). Explicit 'Select all {totalMatching} matching documents' button as separate action

expectations.text: Separates the destructive action from the benign one visually or spatially
expectations.evidence: Archive button: bg-slate-900, Delete button: bg-red-600. Color-coded distinction in same bar

expectations.text: Does not make the destructive action the default focus or primary button
expectations.evidence: Archive button appears first in BulkActionsBar, Delete second. Neither button in dialog has autoFocus attribute

expectations.text: Notes that the server must enforce the rules, not just the UI
expectations.evidence: 'The server must still authorize the bulk endpoint and bind the idempotency key to the mutation payload'

expectations.text: Closes by naming which misuses the design makes impossible
expectations.evidence: Response ends with server enforcement note but does not enumerate prevented misuse scenarios
